title: Freeze contracts C1–C6 as Python modules + JSON Schema
outcome: C1 Envelope, C2 Record, C3 State, C4 Alert/Control, C5 RecoveryPlan, C6 Run dir frozen by 22 Nov as typed modules + JSON Schema, one canonical serializer, JSON-lines-over-Unix-socket transport; every ADR builds on these
acceptance: src/ks/contracts/ has one module + one JSON Schema per C1–C6 with the fields in CALL-01/maya.md §3 (C1 incl. nonce, expiry, epoch, full act chain; C2 incl. read_set, write_set before/after ver+hash, prev_hash, gw_sig; C2 values as hashes only)
pytest round-trip: for each contract, obj → canonical bytes → obj is identity, and the canonical bytes are stable across two runs (byte-equal) and validate against the schema
a single canonical serializer (sorted keys, fixed encoding) is the only one exported and is the one signer, gateway and verify must import
kabir signs off that the contracts satisfy all 11 day-one rules (CALL-01/kabir.md §4), checklist in the review note
summary: Contracts 1.0.0 frozen in src/ks/contracts/ (pydantic v2 frozen models, extra=forbid, field docstrings with OTel gen_ai.*/ks.* mapping) + 14 JSON Schema files (draft 2020-12, all fields required; >=1 per C1-C6) + README. C1 Envelope/EnvelopeHeader (commit-then-sign: agent signs header with args_hash, so verify works after args redaction; nonce, expiry_tick, epoch, full act_chain, claimed_ts_us/claimed_seq evidence-only). C2 Record (seq from 1, tick, logical ts_us, conn_id, embedded signed header = claimed agent_id+act_chain, sig_ok, decision exec|deny|hold, closed Reason enum, action_class R/C/I1/I2/U, read_set (obj,ver,hash), write_set before/after ver+hash, outbox_ids, result_hash, Control in clear, prev_hash, hash, gw_sig; attributed_agent is None unless sig_ok) + WitnessCheckpoint. C3 StateView/StateWriter/SideStore protocols, OutboxItem (author, class, idempotency_key gateway-derived, lineage from recorded read set, status queued|held|released|dispatched|cancelled, dispatched_seq), SideEntry. C4 Alert (no suspect; ranked root_candidates; signature alerts name conn only; tamper names nobody) and Control (target agent:/conn:/action:/outbox:; revoke never auto). C5 RecoveryPlan (taint_set, discriminated steps restore|rerun|replan|cancel_outbox|compensate|flag, hash-only dry-run diff; taint-scoped revert = the restore steps). C6 RunConfig (seed, hold_window_ticks, sensitive_fields), Keyring (public only), RunDir create/validate, verify Exit enum (OK/IO/TAMPER/WITNESS/RECONCILE/FROZEN/USAGE) + VerifyReport. Transport frames for JSON lines over Unix sockets. ONE serializer ks.contracts.canonical (JCS-identical: sorted keys, UTF-8, ints within 2^53, no floats, no bytes, strict loads). Folded in TERMS section 7 and redteam SPEC Q1-Q5, Q7, Q9, Q10; Q6 (score keys) left to ADR-06; Q8 = Exit.FROZEN. pytest: 231 passed (round-trip identity, byte-stable across 2 processes with different hash seeds, schema validation, golden hashes, rule invariants, single-serializer guard).
review: [kabir · changes] SEC-03 (org/reports/SEC-03.md): 4 blockers before the 22 Nov freeze. B1: WitnessCheckpoint lacks the signed count (THREAT-MODEL v3, ADR-02), and keys.json is unanchored (swapping the keyring defeats verify without --head). Add count, a RunAnchor {seq,head,tick,count,keyring_hash,config_hash} and VerifyReport.anchored. B2: DETERMINISTIC_FILES includes keys.json and signed records, which forces seed-derived private keys (seed is public). Drop keys.json, add a determinism_view() without sig/hash fields, and add an ADR-01 test that keys differ across runs. B3: RELEASE 'restores the epoch' (ADR-04 6: pre-suspend epoch) revives presigned envelopes, and expiry_tick is uncapped. Make epochs strictly monotonic per agent and add MAX_EXPIRY_TICKS. B4: canonical.loads/decode_frame raise RecursionError on a 6 KB nested frame (not a ValueError, so no deny/schema record and a possible barrier crash) and a plain ValueError on huge ints. Add MAX_DEPTH=32 and wrap every exception in CanonicalError. 8 fix-before-S4 items (F1 run-dir perms 0644 expose the side store to agent uids; F2 an agent-signed ks.control/ks.recover record validates; F3 expiry-vs-tick invariant; F4 dispatch record; F5 plan approval record; F6 alerts outside the chain; F7 coarse reads; F8 frame/flood budget) and 10 notes. Rules 3 and 6 (apart from B4) pass. Q1-Q10 met except Q6 (deferred). Pseudonymised hashes: accepted with conditions. Global-only chain: accepted. I sign off once B1-B4 land with tests.
